responsibility: This Modula-2 definition module specifies the auxiliary tree-library services implemented by m2treelib.cc. It exports call builders, modify-expression construction, set-address and set-field access helpers, rvalue extraction, field lookup for set records, and bit-test jump generation, giving Modula-2 code access to shared low-level tree utilities used by expression and statement lowering.
same_name_distinction: Modula-2 definition module for the m2treelib group: it exposes the auxiliary tree-library helpers as FOR "C" procedures and a tree_code alias for Modula-2, unlike m2treelib.h's native declarations and m2treelib.cc's implementation.
